ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
RS3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House), B1, Neighborhood Shopping, and
C1, Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 8-F in the area bound by:

a line 72 feet south of and parallel to West 35" Street; the alley next east of and
parallel to South Hasted Street; West 36" Street; and, South Halsted Street

to those of a B3-2, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Odo —

Nicole Lee
Alderwoman, 11% Ward

Common Address:
3509-59 South Halsted Street
